title: TrofimSnickers
description: Created from scratch resource pack that make game 10x times funnier. Some funny images, not big of change.
body:
### TrofimSnickers
![Demonstration of textures](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b5fe69dfb2f87bec0f9380a11867ccf988e28164.png)
> is a fun little resourse pack in which iron turns into steel from Rimworld, beef turns into tea, and a famous singer appears among the pictures. **AND MORE!** 

> Do not take all the content in the resource pack seriously.
